profile.headline: Java Software Developer at Intercontinental Exchange
profile.summary:
Known by most in professional world as Dj. I am a Software Engineer at heart. I have B.S. in Comp Sci and Minor in Mathematics with more than 18 years of experience in the software engineering. My most thrilling academic work involved  work with Nachos, instructional software that allows students to modify and enhance operating system code. My most fun Comp Sci language was Scheme; it was quite interesting and forced one to think outside the box. My most fun professional experience is working with the JEE technology stack. I have dabbled in many fun and enriching technologies such as Asterisk PBX, Drupal, Dojotoolkit, and many others.

My beginning started in a much different place Department Of Energy as an engineer located in Aiken, SC. I decided to do what I loved which was software and here I am. 

Disclaimer: Although I work at ICE, my views or rhetoric do not necessarily reflect those of ICE or its associates.

Specialties: Held Department of Energy Q Clearance and Top Secret Clearance.
